svg.text: EXAMPLE – real design by a qualified electrician
600 mm perforated tray · 12 slots of 50 mm · categories P M C S N
Values from docs/27 and web/instelec_calc.js (example data, crankcase machining line ML1).
Cable tray cross-sections (HMC-01, 8 cables) – the same presets as the tray checker in item 4, card B
a) AS FOUND (bad) – mixed cables, no divider → 12 of 19 pairs fail
b) GOOD – with earthed metal divider (power + motor | control, network, signals)
c) GOOD – by distance only (no divider): signals ≥ 300 mm from motor cables
C control 24 V/230 V · S signal
distance in mm by metal separator type

Drive motor cables are noisier → use
